summary.headline: Annual Astrology and Baghdad
summary.text: Discussion of annual prognostication: Greek mathematicians use the Sun’s entry into Aries, the horoscope, planets, fixed stars, and centers, while Ptolemy adds solstices, lunations, and co-rising stars. Persian astrologers and authorities including Critodemus, Valens, Dorotheus, and Timocharis follow the annual rule; the author applies it to Irenopolis, identified with Baghdad, giving its latitude as 33 degrees.
